searchText: I fixed the issue, Lighthouse was missing the Inclusion List beacon event which seems to have broken something with dora. Whatever kurtosis config you were using should work now if you pull the latest from the LH focil branch Is there a reason why we have the fulu fork before the eip7805 one in the kurtosis setup? In Teku we didn't add anything fulu related yet and that makes it crash when testing focil with prysm. I tried removing the fulu fork epoch from the kurtosis config but it looks like prysm doesn't like that and stops proposing blocks when we reach the eip7805 fork epoch. Is there a way to skip the fulu fork in prysm? I don't think that's Prysm issue? https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1210529202458071050/1351514858822041662 I tried completely removing the fulu_fork_epoch and prysm struggled with that. I'll try setting the same epoch for both fulu and eip7805 Yeah without fulu fork epoch set, ethereum genesis generator doesn't set Osaka time, making EL doesn't think it's in Osaka fork even when it is. With fulu and eip7805 forks set in the same epoch, it should work but Prysm currently doesn't. I'm currently working on it and almost fixed it. Will share working docker images soon. But I think we do need to update ethereum genesis generator so we don't need to set fulu epoch. That's the whole point of rebasing eip7805 onto Electra. I wonder how others think about this. Would be better imo. That's what has been done for epbs cc <@808969530608451584> Uhm, that really depends on the implementation 😄 We usually can't simply skip a fork as client implementations expect forks in the same order. What we've done for epbs is, that we start from a electra genesis, so we can already activate epbs (which builds on top of electra) at epoch 1. That speeded up the testing cycvles a bit as we don't need to wait for electra at epoch 1, just to activate epbs at epoch 2. We can probably do the same for focil, but afaik focil,is based on fulu? so it needs to go through the fulu activation first before focil can be activated? We've decided to rebase focil onto electra as once fulu has PeerDAS, it would mess up with FOCIL The issue is FOCIL changes EL and the new APIs are activated upon Osaka. If we can set Osaka time with eip7805_fork, it would resolve this? <@845691100072509460> FYI, the `tx_spammer` has been renamed to `tx_fuzz`, just raised a PR in your repo to fix that: https://github.com/jihoonsong/local-devnet-focil/pull/1 Merged, thanks a lot!

excerpts.author: mehdi.aouadi
excerpts.content: Is there a reason why we have the fulu fork before the eip7805 one in the kurtosis setup? I tried removing the fulu fork epoch from the kurtosis config but it looks like prysm doesn't like that and stops proposing blocks when we reach the eip7805 fork epoch. Is there a way to skip the fulu fork in prysm?

excerpts.author: jih2nn
excerpts.content:
Yeah without fulu fork epoch set, ethereum genesis generator doesn't set Osaka time, making EL doesn't think it's in Osaka fork even when it is.

With fulu and eip7805 forks set in the same epoch, it should work but Prysm currently doesn't. I'm currently working on it and almost fixed it. Will share working docker images soon.

excerpts.author: jih2nn
excerpts.content: But I think we do need to update ethereum genesis generator so we don't need to set fulu epoch. That's the whole point of rebasing eip7805 onto Electra. I wonder how others think about this.

excerpts.author: mehdi.aouadi
excerpts.content: Would be better imo. That's what has been done for epbs

excerpts.author: pk910
excerpts.content:
Uhm, that really depends on the implementation 😄
We usually can't simply skip a fork as client implementations expect forks in the same order.

What we've done for epbs is, that we start from a electra genesis, so we can already activate epbs (which builds on top of electra) at epoch 1.
That speeded up the testing cycvles a bit as we don't need to wait for electra at epoch 1, just to activate epbs at epoch 2.

We can probably do the same for focil,  but afaik focil,is based on fulu? so it needs to go through the fulu activation first before focil can be activated?

excerpts.author: jih2nn
excerpts.content: We've decided to rebase focil onto electra as once fulu has PeerDAS, it would mess up with FOCIL

excerpts.author: jih2nn
excerpts.content: The issue is FOCIL changes EL and the new APIs are activated upon Osaka. If we can set Osaka time with eip7805_fork, it would resolve this?
